Target Audience: Power users who iterate on prompts across web tools
Risk Notes: Extension permissions must stay tight to retain user trust.
Validation Signals: Test with writers and support agents; track adoption of suggestions and opt-in rates.
Short Description: PromptTriggerBar runs locally to surface high-signal prompt tokens in a ticker bar while you type in whitelisted sites.
Notes: Clear messaging about on-device processing keeps the privacy story credible.
Notes / Edge: Hybrid fuzzy + embedding ranking finds useful triggers without phoning home.
Key features: Browser extension that activates only on user-approved domains.
FastAPI backend with optional SentenceTransformers scoring.
Ticker bar UI that inserts selected prompt tokens at the caret.
Impact: Improves prompt craft efficiency and reduces repetitive typing for heavy LLM users.
Business Model: Freemium extension with pro tier for custom dictionaries and workspace sharing.
Key Metrics: Suggestion acceptance rate, active domains, repeat sessions.
MVP Scope: Deliver extension + backend handshake, fuzzy search, and minimal semantic reranking.
Primary Users: Prompt engineers, support agents, and content teams
